newsitem.title: USA: US to sell $30.75 bln of 2-, 5-yr notes Nov 19, 20.
newsitem.headline: US to sell $30.75 bln of 2-, 5-yr notes Nov 19, 20.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Wednesday that it will sell $18.25 billion of 2-year notes on Nov 19 and $12.5 bln of 5-yr notes on Nov 20 to refund $28.336 billion of securities maturing Nov 30 and to raise $2.425 billion of new cash.
The notes will be issued Dec 2. The two-year notes mature Nov 30, 1998 and the five-year notes mature Nov 30, 2001.
The CUSIP number for the 2-year notes will be 9128272B7 and for the five-year notes will be 9128272C5.
